args.message: 201 customers have placed at least one order. I added up each customer's order amounts and put them in revenue bands labelled by their lower bound. Six orders have no customer ID, so I left them out because they can't be assigned to anyone. Counting them as one extra customer would have made the under-1000 band 62 instead of 61.
